dataPack.title: Practice data pack
dataPack.text: A made-up company, Lakeview Supply Co., that sells supplies and services to other businesses, April to September 2026: orders, customer feedback, support tickets, a carrier invoice, a customer inbox and more. The Set up mission puts it all in your Cowork Academy folder. There are real patterns hidden inside.

edition.roleNote: Two hours of missions for your part of the business, in any industry, using your own work or the practice data pack.
edition.explorerOutcome: Turn a customer inbox into a sorted to-do list
edition.capPlaceholder: Built an orders report and chart; idea: automate the Monday summary

ideaExample.task: copying numbers from three systems into a weekly report
ideaExample.what: build the report from the exports automatically

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.blurb: New to Cowork? Start here. Make the everyday files your job runs on, a Word letter, a working spreadsheet and a team page, then research, use a skill and connect an app, with every step spelled out.
bullets: Word letter, team tracker and a one-page team page
Research, a simple logo and your first skill
beginner.sub: A guided tour of everyday Cowork using your job and the practice files: real Word and Excel files, a one-page team page, web research, a skill and a connected app.

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.project: Run a small business with Cowork
intermediate.blurb: Comfortable with the basics? Build a small company's toolkit: a business brief, a website, your own saved skill, a research brief, data analysis, a deck, a PDF, a scheduled summary and a dashboard.
bullets: Business brief, website and your own skill
Data analysis, a deck and a client-ready PDF
A scheduled summary and a refreshable dashboard
intermediate.sub: You’ll build the everyday toolkit of a small company, using its brief and the practice data, and learn the habits that make results reliable.

higher.name: Higher
higher.blurb: Ready to stretch? Plan and build a connected workflow: a product plan, a multi-page site, a delegation brief, two apps working together, a dashboard, optional browser and desktop control, and a chained workflow.
bullets: Product plan, multi-page site and a delegation brief
Two apps working together and a dashboard
Optional browser and desktop control, then chain it all
higher.sub: For confident users. Prompts are half-written: you decide the goals and what good looks like, and judge the results against them.

roles.name: Customer Service and Support
roles.who: For people who answer customers, solve problems and keep them coming back.
outcomes: A saved skill that drafts on-policy customer replies
Feedback themes and fixes, with the numbers
A help guide and a sorted inbox
roles.label: customer service and support

roles.name: Operations
roles.who: For coordinators and managers who keep the work flowing and fix what slows it down.
outcomes: The real causes of delays, with the numbers
A checklist tool your team can use on a phone
roles.label: operations

roles.name: Finance and Administration
roles.who: For accounting, finance and admin teams, and anyone who owns the numbers.
outcomes: Orders analyzed by channel and month
A pricing-scenario model with working formulas
A vendor invoice checked for mistakes
roles.label: finance and administration

roles.name: Sales and Marketing
roles.who: For people who win and keep customers and tell the company story.
outcomes: A product-description skill in your brand voice
A customer pitch deck and a customer update
roles.label: sales and marketing

roles.name: Leaders and Managers
roles.who: For anyone who runs a team and wants their people bringing AI ideas forward.
outcomes: A KPI dashboard from the practice data
A team idea huddle that feeds Spark
roles.label: leading a team
